# Tools and intents

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py - do not edit by hand. -->

The model never touches the database or the network directly. It can only *request* one of
the tools below; the executor ([agent.md](agent.md#6-tool-execution)) then checks the intent's
allow-list, the per-turn budgets, the argument schema and the caller's permission before the
handler runs - and every handler goes through the same services (and ownership checks) as the
REST API. Side effects: **read** (no change), **write** (low-risk, audited),
**propose** (creates a pending action the customer must confirm through the API - the model
can never complete a refund or cancellation on its own), **escalate** (hands over to a human).

## Tools

### `get_order_status`

Look up the shipping status of ONE of the signed-in customer's orders: status, ship/delivery dates, carrier, tracking number and items. Call this whenever the customer asks where an order is or when it will arrive and gives an order number.

- Side effect: **read**
- Permission: `order:read_own`
- Calls per turn: at most 3
- Allowed for intents: `order_tracking`, `cancellation`, `shipping_question`, `complaint`

| Parameter | Type | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `order_number` | str | max length 16, pattern `^ORD-\d{6,10}$` | The order reference, e.g. ORD-100234. |

### `list_recent_orders`

List the signed-in customer's most recent orders (number, date, status, total). Call this when the customer refers to an order without giving its number.

- Side effect: **read**
- Permission: `order:read_own`
- Calls per turn: at most 1
- Allowed for intents: `order_tracking`, `refund_request`, `payment_problem`, `cancellation`, `complaint`

| Parameter | Type | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | int | >= 1, <= 10 | How many recent orders to list (1-10). |

### `get_order_details`

Get the items, prices, totals and masked payment summary of one of the customer's orders. Call this for questions about what was ordered or what it cost.

- Side effect: **read**
- Permission: `order:read_own`
- Calls per turn: at most 3
- Allowed for intents: `order_tracking`, `refund_request`, `payment_problem`

| Parameter | Type | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `order_number` | str | max length 16, pattern `^ORD-\d{6,10}$` | The order reference, e.g. ORD-100234. |

### `check_payment_status`

Check the payment state of one of the customer's orders (captured, failed, refunded) and any refunded total. Call this for charge, billing or failed-payment questions.

- Side effect: **read**
- Permission: `payment:read_own`
- Calls per turn: at most 3
- Allowed for intents: `payment_problem`

| Parameter | Type | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `order_number` | str | max length 16, pattern `^ORD-\d{6,10}$` | The order reference, e.g. ORD-100234. |

### `check_refund_eligibility`

Apply the store's refund policy to one of the customer's orders and return whether it is eligible, why not, and the maximum refundable amount. Always call this before discussing a refund amount.

- Side effect: **read**
- Permission: `refund:read_own`
- Calls per turn: at most 3
- Allowed for intents: `refund_request`

| Parameter | Type | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `order_number` | str | max length 16, pattern `^ORD-\d{6,10}$` | The order reference, e.g. ORD-100234. |

### `get_refund_status`

List refunds on one of the customer's orders with their status. Call this for 'where is my refund'.

- Side effect: **read**
- Permission: `refund:read_own`
- Calls per turn: at most 3
- Allowed for intents: `refund_request`, `payment_problem`

| Parameter | Type | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `order_number` | str | max length 16, pattern `^ORD-\d{6,10}$` | The order reference, e.g. ORD-100234. |

### `request_refund`

Prepare a refund request for an eligible order. This does NOT refund anything: it creates a request the customer must confirm in the app, which staff then review. Call it only when the customer explicitly asks for a refund.

- Side effect: **propose**
- Permission: `refund:request_own`
- Calls per turn: at most 1
- Allowed for intents: `refund_request`

| Parameter | Type | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `order_number` | str | max length 16, pattern `^ORD-\d{6,10}$` | The order reference, e.g. ORD-100234. |
| `reason` | one of `damaged`, `defective`, `wrong_item`, `not_as_described`, `no_longer_needed`, `late_delivery`, `order_cancelled`, `other` | - | Why the customer wants a refund. |
| `note` | str or null | max length 500 | Optional short note in the customer's words, or null. |

### `cancel_order`

Prepare the cancellation of an order that has not shipped. Nothing changes until the customer confirms in the app. Call it only when the customer explicitly asks to cancel.

- Side effect: **propose**
- Permission: `order:cancel_own`
- Calls per turn: at most 1
- Allowed for intents: `cancellation`

| Parameter | Type | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `order_number` | str | max length 16, pattern `^ORD-\d{6,10}$` | The order reference, e.g. ORD-100234. |

### `create_support_ticket`

Open a support ticket for an issue that needs follow-up by the support team (e.g. a technical fault you cannot resolve). Do not use it for questions you can answer.

- Side effect: **write**
- Permission: `ticket:create_own`
- Calls per turn: at most 1
- Allowed for intents: `account_problem`, `technical_problem`, `complaint`

| Parameter | Type | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subject` | str | min length 3, max length 150 | A short summary of the issue. |
| `description` | str | min length 10, max length 2000 | What happened and what the customer needs, without card numbers or passwords. |

### `get_ticket_status`

Look up one of the customer's support tickets by its reference number.

- Side effect: **read**
- Permission: `ticket:read_own`
- Calls per turn: at most 3
- Allowed for intents: `technical_problem`, `general_question`

| Parameter | Type | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ticket_number` | str | max length 16, pattern `^TCK-\d{6,10}$` | The ticket reference, e.g. TCK-40718263. |

### `get_product_information`

Look up products in the public catalogue by SKU or name: price, warranty, availability and a short description. Call this for product questions.

- Side effect: **read**
- Permission: `product:read`
- Calls per turn: at most 3
- Allowed for intents: `product_question`, `technical_problem`

| Parameter | Type | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sku` | str or null | max length 32, pattern `^[A-Z]{2,4}-[A-Z0-9]{2,8}-\d{2,4}$` | Exact product SKU if known (e.g. ACM-SB500-01), else null. |
| `query` | str or null | max length 80 | Product name or keywords when the SKU is unknown, else null. |

### `get_customer_profile`

Get the signed-in customer's first name, membership tier and number of orders.

- Side effect: **read**
- Permission: `order:read_own`
- Calls per turn: at most 1
- Allowed for intents: `account_problem`, `general_question`

| Parameter | Type | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

### `request_human_agent`

Hand the conversation to a human support specialist. Call this when the customer asks for a human, reports a hacked account or unauthorised charges, mentions legal action, needs an exception to policy, or when you cannot help.

- Side effect: **escalate**
- Permission: `escalation:request`
- Calls per turn: at most 1
- Allowed for intents: `order_tracking`, `refund_request`, `payment_problem`, `cancellation`, `shipping_question`, `product_question`, `account_problem`, `technical_problem`, `security_problem`, `complaint`, `general_question`

| Parameter | Type | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `reason` | one of `customer_request`, `account_security`, `payment_risk`, `legal`, `unsupported_request`, `policy_exception`, `sensitive_data`, `negative_sentiment` | - | Why a human needs to take over. |
| `summary` | str | min length 5, max length 500 | One or two sentences for the human agent summarising the issue. |

## Intents

Defined in `src/aegis/agents/intents.toml` and validated at start-up.

| Intent | Description | Default priority | Knowledge searched | Always escalates |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `order_tracking` | Where an order is, delivery status or date, tracking numbers, late or missing packages. | medium | `shipping_policy`, `faq` | no |
| `refund_request` | Asking for a refund or return, refund eligibility, or the status of a refund. | medium | `refund_policy`, `faq` | no |
| `payment_problem` | Charges, failed or declined payments, double charges, billing and invoices. | high | `payment_policy`, `faq` | no |
| `cancellation` | Cancelling an order or asking whether an order can still be cancelled. | medium | `cancellation_policy`, `refund_policy` | no |
| `shipping_question` | General shipping questions: costs, times, destinations, carriers, express delivery. | low | `shipping_policy`, `faq` | no |
| `product_question` | Product features, compatibility, setup, availability, price or warranty coverage. | low | `product_docs`, `warranty`, `faq` | no |
| `account_problem` | Sign-in trouble, password resets, account settings, e-mail or profile changes. | medium | `account_policy`, `faq` | no |
| `technical_problem` | A device or the website/app not working: errors, faults, crashes, setup failures. | medium | `product_docs`, `warranty`, `faq` | no |
| `security_problem` | Account compromise, unauthorised orders or charges, fraud, phishing, suspicious logins. | urgent | `account_policy` | yes |
| `complaint` | Dissatisfaction with the service, a product or an experience; requests for a manager. | high | `faq` | no |
| `general_question` | Anything else about the store: opening hours, contact options, policies, privacy, tickets. | low | `faq`, `privacy_policy`, `account_policy`, `shipping_policy`, `refund_policy`, `warranty`, `payment_policy`, `cancellation_policy` | no |
